sources.measurement_method: FeatureServer closed polygon rings converted to the documented local meters frame; compared source vertices with the audit reference derived from the same feature. Source/reference ring difference is exactly 0 m; saved shell ring differs by at most 0.00001472 m from the map coordinates due to Blender float precision. This is faithful reproduction of the source, not an independent survey check.
sources.uncertainty: Purdue campus-map polygon is not certified survey data; dimensions and translation agreement are inherited from source coordinate conversion; exact overlay comparison is not an independent survey check. Attribute height fields (Extrution/R) are explicitly excluded.

geometry_edits: Replaced single generic 16 m massing block with exact campus-map ring prism and five visible above-grade levels (17.25 m estimated).
Added schematic low flat-roof mechanical penthouse; not sourced to measured roof survey.
Added repeated narrow dark glazing, limestone-colored jambs/sills/headers and horizontal floor belts, based on Purdue facade photograph.
Added ground-level accessible glass entry and identification sign at the longest facade edge; exact orientation/location is estimated.
Retained campus world coordinates and identity placement; no master marker or manifest edits.
validation_status: PASS (8.2/10 independent grade); reopened in Blender 5.2.0 LTS, expected collection found with 6 objects, shell boundary max error 0.00001472 m, no modifiers/external images/linked libraries. Height and facade details retain the limitations listed below.
uncertainties: Source map polygon is not a survey; no independent field survey available.
Above-grade floor heights, total height, and roof mechanical arrangement are estimates.
Six levels including basement are described in Purdue report; basement is below grade and not modeled.
Purdue CCE states three construction phases (1950, 1961, 1986), but public sources reviewed do not identify separate phase footprint/elevation limits.
Facade rhythm follows the official photo qualitatively; exact window counts, dimensions, entrance-side assignment, and stone/brick boundaries are not georeferenced.

Independent grader found the official photograph shows a prominent tall central pale-stone/glazed bay not represented by this model. The photo is not georeferenced to a specific facade plane, so the feature was recorded as a visible omission rather than added at an assumed location.

independent_grade.reviewer: separate independent evaluator agent (Hanley lane; no HAMP asset edits)
findings: Position/shape are tied to Purdue GIS and the project approximate lon/lat conversion; the feature is not a certified survey.
No source provides surveyed elevations or floor-to-floor heights; roof penthouse is schematic and unsupported by the supplied evidence.

The source photograph shows a dominant tall central glazed and pale-stone atrium/bay that is absent from the model; current model reads as uniform horizontal brick-and-window rows. Entrance form and precise location remain schematic.
